(() => { const a = window.app; const b = a.game.buildings.list.filter(b => b.plant && b.built >= 1 && !b.plant.site).sort((x, y) => (y.plant.level ?? 1) - (x.plant.level ?? 1))[0]; a.lookAt(b.c, 260); a.selected = b; a.hud.openBuilding(b); })()

steps.eval: (() => { const a = window.app; const t = [...a.game.towns.list].sort((x, y) => y.pop - x.pop)[0]; a.hud.showTown(t.id); })()

steps.eval: (() => { const a = window.app, g = a.game; const n = [...g.net.nodeGeom.entries()].find(([, ng]) => ng.kind === 'junction' && ng.arms.length >= 3)[0]; const nd = g.net.nodes.get(n); a.lookAt(nd.p, 120); a.hud.openSignal(n); })()
